title: ACME Conductor SignedCertificateReconcileJob v1alpha1
description: A CertificateReconcileJob wrapped in a signed, expiring envelope (JWS construction, RFC 7515 with the EdDSA algorithm of RFC 8037): 'signature' is the Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of 'protected', a period, and 'payload'. 'protected' is the base64url (unpadded) JSON header {alg, kid, issuedAt, expiresAt, nonce}; 'payload' is the base64url (unpadded) JobSpec document exactly as the producer serialized it. The envelope detects tampering in transit and bounds replay; it does not replace the Runner's own authorization of the unwrapped JobSpec. Go validation (pkg/api/v1alpha1/signedjob.go) is authoritative and stricter than this schema: it decodes and checks the header, verifies the signature against trusted keys, and enforces the validity window.

protected.description: base64url (no padding) of the JSON protected header. Decoded, it is a strict JSON object {"alg":"EdDSA","kid":"<16 lower-case hex>","issuedAt":<RFC 3339>,"expiresAt":<RFC 3339>,"nonce":"<16..128 base64url chars>"} with no other members; expiresAt must be after issuedAt and at most 24 hours later.

payload.description: base64url (no padding) of the CertificateReconcileJob document (jobspec.schema.json), at most 65536 bytes decoded.

signature.description: base64url (no padding) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
